description: Local admission removes the lower option before ordinary action ranking. The neutral reading wins the remaining ordinary comparison (engine §2.1 and §6.1).
grammar:
%ambiguity-resolution lazy
%rule text (favored ≻ disfavored) | neutral
%rule favored (A B C D)
%rule disfavored (early C D)
%rule early (A B)
%rule neutral (middle D)
%rule middle (A B C)
